items.title: Kelly wins Senior Open as Gallacher lights up final round at Gleneagles
items.summary: Jerry Kelly won the ISPS HANDA Senior Open at Gleneagles by two shots as he claimed a third PGA Tour Champions major of his career.

Littler dominates Price to close out historic Blackpool title defence
items.summary: Luke Littler capped off a remarkable title defence at the World Matchplay Darts with an impressive 18-9 victory over Gerwyn Price in Blackpool.

items.title: PSG pull out of Diomande race - Real confident of signing forward
items.summary: Paris Saint-Germain have pulled out of the race to sign RB Leipzig forward Yan Diomande, with Real Madrid now increasingly confident of landing the Ivory Coast international.

items.title: Japan legend Miura, 59, scores first goal since 2022
items.summary: Kazuyoshi Miura, the world's oldest professional footballer, scores his first goal in nearly four years at the age of 59 for Japanese third-tier side Fukushima United.

items.title: McInnes teases Rangers signing within 48 hours
